calibration.objective: hard-label NLL on validation records only
calibration.limitations: Global calibration only; validation fit is not held-out test performance. No weight changes.

metric_notes.failures: Included as incorrect in accuracy; excluded from probability metrics with explicit n.
metric_notes.ece: 10 equal-width bins of maximum class probability, not API confidence.
metric_notes.nll: Natural log; probabilities floored at 1e-12 for this metric only.
metric_notes.brier: Multiclass sum of squared errors; binary Brier also reported for Noul.
metric_notes.noul_threshold: Yes when P(yes) >= 0.5, including an exact tie.
metric_notes.ordinal: Zero-based expected score MAE and normalized ranked probability score.
metric_notes.human: TVD to normalized human vote shares, where provided.

notes: No weight training. Raw test probabilities replay the same saved logits without fitted calibration.
End-to-end evaluation latency includes Python and per-readout GPU memory safety queries; it is not HTTP service throughput.
Memory observations are checkpoints, not a continuous peak measurement.
Synthetic context probes test fact retrieval, not general long-document comprehension.
No hosted Jev requests. Third-party public prediction reanalysis is stored separately.
